title: Plugin tool callback state is shared across EditorSessions
body: Found by Codex at 0.9.2 (src/plugin_host/plugin_tool.cpp): registered plugin tool callback state lives per registration, not per session, so two simultaneous sessions would share it. Needs per-session instances and a test (two sessions, tool state independent). Also: tool ABI exposes only world-line overlay segments, not every internal overlay primitive (0.9.5 overlays).
